arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{if:SF_22}{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}{Combat Effect Chance}%{/c}
{/if}{/if}Create a subversive ritual for {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} seconds that {c_important}{u}Hexes{/u}{/c} enemies.

Killing {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual to send forth shadow trails for {c_number}[{SF_8}|1|]{/c} seconds that periodically grant you {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} while in them. 

You can have up to {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} trails active at once.

{c_important}Sigil of Subversion{/c} trails now last {c_number}[{SF_14}*100|%|]{/c} longer and extend away when you near their ends. While within a trail your {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} loses no stacks while moving.
{c_important}Sigil of Subversion{/c} trails teleport Non-Boss enemies back to the ritual area the first time they come in contact.

{c_important}Sigil of Subversion{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and now creates lava trails that periodically deal {c_number}{payload:LAVA_IMPACT}{/c} damage. Enemies that die within the trails have a {c_number}[{SF_15}*100|%|]{/c} chance to be charred into {c_important}{u}Brimstones{/u}{/c} which deal {c_number}{payload:BS_PAYLOAD_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage when they explode.
{c_important}Sigil of Subversion{/c} trails grant you {c_number}[{SF_21}*100|x%|]{/c} increased Movement Speed while on them.

Sacrifice {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life to instantly trigger each of {c_important}Sigil of Subversion's{/c} kill costs, up to {c_number}[{SF_27}*{SF_10}*{SF_9}*100|%|]{/c} total.
{c_important}Sigil of Subversion{/c} trails Slow enemies by {c_number}[{SF_24}*100|%|]{/c}.
{c_important}Sigil of Subversion{/c} can now be placed at long range.
